blockers.description: User wants the phone screen to turn off/lock when Android Auto connects, but a standard Android app cannot force a physical screen-off without special permissions (e.g. device admin). Realistic options are releasing FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON and/or showing a neutral 'connected to Android Auto' state and letting the system's own timeout take over.
blockers.workaround: Not yet resolved — needs to be nailed down precisely during research and/or requirements definition (Step 9). Do not silently promise a literal forced screen-off in REQUIREMENTS.md.

human_actions_pending.action: Answer the Research Decision question: research Android Auto / Car App Library constraints first, or skip straight to requirements
human_actions_pending.context: research_enabled defaults to false for this project, but Android Auto has strict, poorly-known constraints on which app categories/templates can draw custom UI (e.g. requires declaring as 'navigation' category to get a drawable surface) — recommended to research first given the technical uncertainty

decisions.decision: Milestone v2.0 scope: project current GPS speed onto the Android Auto car screen via Google's Car App Library
decisions.rationale: User explicitly wants the number visible on the car/moto display, not just phone-side compatibility

decisions.decision: Likely approach: declare the app under the 'navigation' Car App Library category to get access to a drawable Surface, since there is no generic 'just show a number' template
decisions.rationale: Car App Library restricts custom UI to specific app categories/templates; navigation category is the one known to expose a raw drawable surface

decisions.decision: Car display shows ONLY current speed + 'no GPS signal' state — no max speed, no distance
decisions.rationale: User explicitly deselected max speed and distance for the car display; those stay phone-only, consistent with Core Value (keep car display minimal)

decisions.decision: Phone screen behavior when Android Auto connects: intended to turn off/lock (exact mechanism TBD — see blockers)
decisions.rationale: User assumes attention shifts entirely to the car screen once connected

next_action: Resume /gsd:new-milestone (or re-enter this workflow) at Step 8 'Research Decision': ask the user again whether to research Android Auto / Car App Library constraints before defining requirements, recommending 'Research first' given the technical uncertainty about app categories and drawable-surface access.
